related.title: Notary Project：倉庫範圍、信任身分與驗證層級
related.titleEn: Notary Project: registry scopes, trusted identities and verification levels
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：60%與70%可重算，錯平台與內容替換都拒絕；索引簽章不被描述成跨平台二進位相同。 交付oci-platform-chain.json、tag改指向負例與平台匹配表；本課不拉取或執行未知容器。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 60 and 70 percent and reject platform and content substitutions. An index signature is not described as proof of identical binaries across architectures. Deliver oci-platform-chain.json, tag-retargeting counterexamples and the platform matrix. The exercise downloads or executes no unknown container images.
related.difference: 建立12個OCI產物URI與簽章描述，列registryScopes、trustStores、trustedIdentities與驗證層級；先固定所用規格版本，不假設所有版本支援相同blob範圍。
related.differenceEn: Build 12 OCI artifact URIs and signature descriptors with registryScopes, trustStores, trustedIdentities and verification level. Pin the specification version and OCI scope, avoiding assumptions about blob-policy support across releases.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本地准入要求平台契約符合且選中manifest摘要在已審查集合；tag只做顯示，不當穩定識別。索引摘要與子摘要各有不同範圍，不能互相代換。 10筆中8筆平台選擇正確，其中6筆子manifest摘要已核准；2筆平台錯誤即使摘要已知仍不通過。 完整准入率6/10×100=60%；為一筆正確平台補齊子manifest審查後變7/10×100=70%。
本課要求命中預期倉庫政策、可信身分與指定檢查皆通過；未匹配政策不授權。此課沒有將Notation說成原生支援n-of-m多簽門檻。 12筆中10筆命中正確scope，當中7筆身分與驗證要求全符合；其他列保留無政策、錯身分或過期等具體原因。 完整通過率7/12×100≈58.333%；修正一筆scope已正確但信任store選錯的設定後為8/12×100≈66.667%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The local gate requires platform compatibility and a selected manifest digest in the reviewed set. Tags remain display labels. Index and child-manifest digests identify different objects and cannot be substituted for one another in verification. Eight of ten deployments select the intended platform, and six of those use an approved child digest. Two platform-mismatched deployments remain rejected even if their digest appears elsewhere in an approved inventory. Full admission is 6/10×100=60 percent. Completing child-manifest review for one correctly selected platform yields 7/10×100=70 percent without changing the requested platform or the other descriptors.

The local gate requires the intended repository policy, trusted identity and configured checks to pass. No matching policy means no approval. This exercise does not claim that the Notary trust-policy model natively supplies an n-of-m signature quorum. Ten of 12 artifacts match the correct scope, and seven of those satisfy identity and verification requirements. Preserve concrete reasons such as no policy, wrong signer or expired evidence rather than combining them into one ambiguous failure. Full acceptance is 7/12×100, approximately 58.333 percent. Repairing one correctly scoped artifact with the wrong selected trust store yields 8/12×100, approximately 66.667 percent, without widening repository scope.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: PEP610：直接URL來源、不可變commit與安裝證據
related.titleEn: PEP 610: direct URL origins, immutable commits and installed evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：60%與70%可重算，錯平台與內容替換都拒絕；索引簽章不被描述成跨平台二進位相同。 交付oci-platform-chain.json、tag改指向負例與平台匹配表；本課不拉取或執行未知容器。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 60 and 70 percent and reject platform and content substitutions. An index signature is not described as proof of identical binaries across architectures. Deliver oci-platform-chain.json, tag-retargeting counterexamples and the platform matrix. The exercise downloads or executes no unknown container images.
related.difference: 建立10份安裝來源描述，分VCS、archive與local directory；對VCS列完整commit，對archive列核准摘要，editable安裝另外標示可變。
related.differenceEn: Build ten installed-origin descriptors covering VCS, archives and local directories. Record complete commits for VCS, approved digests for archives and explicit mutability for editable installations, preserving the distinct schema shapes rather than forcing every origin into one field.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本地准入要求平台契約符合且選中manifest摘要在已審查集合；tag只做顯示，不當穩定識別。索引摘要與子摘要各有不同範圍，不能互相代換。 10筆中8筆平台選擇正確，其中6筆子manifest摘要已核准；2筆平台錯誤即使摘要已知仍不通過。 完整准入率6/10×100=60%；為一筆正確平台補齊子manifest審查後變7/10×100=70%。
本課穩定來源覆蓋要求能連到已核准不可變來源；branch/tag只是請求名稱，commit_id是解析版本。來源中繼資料本身不是已安裝位元組的簽章。 10份中6份有完整且核准的不可變來源，2份僅分支名稱、2份editable目錄；本課將後四份列為未滿足固定來源政策。 穩定來源覆蓋6/10×100=60%；補齊一份分支安裝的實際核准commit後為7/10×100=70%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The local gate requires platform compatibility and a selected manifest digest in the reviewed set. Tags remain display labels. Index and child-manifest digests identify different objects and cannot be substituted for one another in verification. Eight of ten deployments select the intended platform, and six of those use an approved child digest. Two platform-mismatched deployments remain rejected even if their digest appears elsewhere in an approved inventory. Full admission is 6/10×100=60 percent. Completing child-manifest review for one correctly selected platform yields 7/10×100=70 percent without changing the requested platform or the other descriptors.

Stable-origin coverage requires an approved immutable source association. Branches and tags are requested names while commit_id identifies the resolved revision. Origin metadata is not itself a signature over the currently installed filesystem bytes. Six of ten descriptors have complete approved immutable origins, two retain only branch names and two point to editable directories. The latter four do not satisfy the fixed-origin policy selected for this release exercise. Stable-origin coverage is 6/10×100=60 percent. Recording and approving the actual commit for one branch-origin installation raises it to 7/10×100=70 percent, without making editable directories immutable.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
